1	"""Per-parameter KL divergence of the posterior from the prior, M1_210210.
     2	
     3	For each sampled scalar parameter, D_KL(posterior || prior) in bits from the
     4	nested-sampling dead points (``marginal_kl_bits`` in
     5	``scripts/per_galaxy_diagnostics.py``). Each fit is compared with its own stored
     6	prior. The SFR ratios are replaced by log10 SFR per SFH bin (M_sun/yr), a
     7	derived quantity: its prior is a sample of every sampled parameter drawn from
     8	the stored priors and pushed through the notebook's SFH conversion, and the
     9	empirical CDF of that sample plays the role of the prior CDF. Writes a sorted
    10	bar chart and its table to ``wiki/analyses/m1-210210-reference/``.
    11	
    12	Usage: ``JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu ceridwen/.venv/bin/python scripts/plot_prior_kl.py``
    13	"""
    14	
    15	from __future__ import annotations
    16	
    17	import functools
    18	import sys
    19	from pathlib import Path
    20	
    21	import matplotlib
    22	import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    23	import numpy as np
    24	import pandas as pd
    25	
    26	PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    27	sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_ROOT / "scripts"))
    28	import per_galaxy_diagnostics as pgd  # noqa: E402
    29	
    30	TARGET = "M1_210210"
    31	REFERENCE = PROJECT_ROOT / "results/m1-210210-reference"
    32	OUT_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / "wiki/analyses/m1-210210-reference"
    33	FITS = {
    34	    "A": (PROJECT_ROOT / "results/dr2-quiescent-new-defaults" / f"210210-{TARGET}", "k",
    35	          r"A: order 3, $\tau_{\mathrm{dust}} < 2$"),
    36	    "C": (REFERENCE / "tau-1/poly10" / f"210210-{TARGET}", "tab:red",
    37	          r"C: order 10, $\tau_{\mathrm{dust}} < 1$, free $z$, $\sigma_\star$"),
    38	}
    39	LABELS = {
    40	    "logmass": r"$\log_{10}(M_\star/M_\odot)$", "Z": r"$[\mathrm{Fe}/\mathrm{H}]$",
    41	    "afe": r"$[\alpha/\mathrm{Fe}]$", "diffuse_tau_kc": r"$\tau_{\mathrm{dust}}$",
    42	    "diffuse_dust_index": r"$\delta_{\mathrm{dust}}$", "log_f_calib": r"$\log f_{\mathrm{calib}}$",
    43	    "spectrum_scaling": "spectrum scaling", "zred": r"$z$", "sigma_smooth": r"$\sigma_\star$",
    44	    "dust_ratio": r"$\tau_{\mathrm{bc}}/\tau_{\mathrm{dust}}$",
    45	    "zh_beta_unit": r"$u_\beta$",
    46	}
    47	N_BOOT = 200
    48	PRIOR_SAMPLE_MULT = 10  # prior reference sample = this many times the dead points; keeps its own noise near the bootstrap error
    49	SEED = 20260832
    50	
    51	
    52	def label(name, j, edges_gyr):
    53	    """Row label; an SFH bin is named by its two lookback-time edges."""
    54	    if name != "log_sfr_bin":
    55	        return LABELS[name]
    56	    a, b = (f"{t:.3g}" for t in edges_gyr[j:j + 2])
    57	    return rf"$\log_{{10}}\mathrm{{SFR}}$ {a}-{b} Gyr"
    58	
    59	
    60	@functools.cache
    61	def _sfh_nodes_fn():
    62	    """Compiled once per process: ``logsfr_ratios_to_sfh`` over rows of ratios."""
    63	    import jax
    64	    from ceridwen.model import logsfr_ratios_to_sfh
    65	
    66	    return jax.jit(jax.vmap(lambda r, t: logsfr_ratios_to_sfh(r, sfh_times_yr=t), in_axes=(0, None)))
    67	
    68	
    69	def _sfh_nodes(logsfr_ratios, times_yr):
    70	    return _sfh_nodes_fn()(logsfr_ratios, times_yr)
    71	
    72	
    73	def log_sfr_bins(logmass, logsfr_ratios, edges_gyr) -> np.ndarray:
    74	    """log10 SFR [M_sun/yr] in each SFH bin, shape (n, bins).
    75	
    76	    ``logsfr_ratios_to_sfh`` (the notebook's ``sfh_from_ratios``) gives the
    77	    unit-mass SFR at the bin edges; the bin SFR is the mean of its two edges
    78	    (the notebook's ``interval_masses`` over the bin width) times 10**logmass.
    79	    """
    80	    times_yr = np.asarray(edges_gyr, dtype=float) * 1e9
    81	    nodes = np.asarray(_sfh_nodes(np.asarray(logsfr_ratios, dtype=float), times_yr))
    82	    with np.errstate(divide="ignore"):  # extreme prior draws underflow to SFR 0, log10 -inf; ranks stay valid
    83	        return np.asarray(logmass, dtype=float)[:, None] + np.log10(0.5 * (nodes[:, :-1] + nodes[:, 1:]))
    84	
    85	
    86	def student_t_quantile_df2(u, loc=0.0, scale=1.0):
    87	    """Inverse CDF of the location-scale Student-t distribution with df = 2.
    88	
    89	    Closed form (standard t, then ``loc + scale * Q``): Q(p) = 2 (p - 1/2)
    90	    sqrt(2 / alpha) with alpha = 4 p (1 - p). Source: Wikipedia,
    91	    "Quantile function" section "Student's t-distribution"
    92	    (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quantile_function#Student's_t-distribution):
    93	    "Simple formulas exist when nu = 1, 2, 4". TFP's iterative quantile is
    94	    ~1 s per (26600, 7) call; this is microseconds.
    95	    """
    96	    u = np.asarray(u, dtype=float)
    97	    with np.errstate(divide="ignore", invalid="ignore"):  # u = 0 or 1 maps to -/+inf, as the quantile does
    98	        alpha = 4.0 * u * (1.0 - u)
    99	        standard = 2.0 * (u - 0.5) * np.sqrt(2.0 / alpha)
   100	    return loc + scale * standard
   101	
   102	
   103	def _prior_quantile(prior, u):
   104	    """``unit_transform`` with the exact df = 2 Student-t closed form where it applies."""
   105	    if type(prior).__name__ == "StudentT" and float(prior.params["df"]) == 2.0:
   106	        return student_t_quantile_df2(
   107	            u, loc=float(prior.params["mean"]), scale=float(prior.params["scale"])
   108	        )
   109	    return prior.unit_transform(u)
   110	
   111	
   112	def prior_draws(galaxy, n, rng, names=None) -> dict:
   113	    """``n`` draws of the sampled parameters ``names`` (default all) from the fit's stored priors."""
   114	    draws = {}
   115	    for name in names or galaxy.prior_text:
   116	        text = galaxy.prior_text[name]
   117	        size = np.asarray(galaxy.samples[name]).reshape(len(galaxy.log_weights), -1).shape[1]
   118	        u = rng.uniform(0.0, 1.0, (n, size))
   119	        draws[name] = np.asarray(_prior_quantile(pgd.parse_prior(text), u), dtype=float).reshape(n, size)
   120	    return draws
   121	
   122	
   123	def prior_log_sfr_bins(galaxy, rng, n=None) -> np.ndarray:
   124	    """Prior sample of log10 SFR per SFH bin: prior draws through the SFH conversion."""
   125	    n = len(galaxy.log_weights) if n is None else n
   126	    d = prior_draws(galaxy, n, rng, names=("logmass", "logsfr_ratios"))
   127	    return log_sfr_bins(d["logmass"][:, 0], d["logsfr_ratios"], galaxy.sfh_edges_gyr)
   128	
   129	
   130	def empirical_unit_values(values, prior_sample) -> np.ndarray:
   131	    """u = F_prior(x) with F the empirical CDF of ``prior_sample`` (mid-rank for ties)."""
   132	    s = np.sort(np.asarray(prior_sample, dtype=float))
   133	    x = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
   134	    return 0.5 * (np.searchsorted(s, x, "left") + np.searchsorted(s, x, "right")) / len(s)
   135	
   136	
   137	def log_sfr_noise_floor(galaxy, seed=SEED, repeats=200) -> float:
   138	    """95th percentile of the SFH-bin KL when the posterior is itself a prior sample.
   139	
   140	    Same estimator as the notebook's floor (uniform u under the posterior
   141	    weights) but with u from the empirical prior CDF of a finite sample.
   142	    """
   143	    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
   144	    w = pgd.posterior_weights(galaxy)
   145	    n = len(w)
   146	    reference = prior_log_sfr_bins(galaxy, rng, n=PRIOR_SAMPLE_MULT * n)
   147	    bins = rng.integers(reference.shape[1], size=repeats)
   148	    # One batched prior draw for all repeats: a single quantile call per
   149	    # parameter reshaped to (repeats, n, bins). Same distribution as one draw
   150	    # per repeat, different Monte Carlo draws at the same seed.
   151	    d = prior_draws(galaxy, repeats * n, rng, names=("logmass", "logsfr_ratios"))
   152	    log_sfr = log_sfr_bins(d["logmass"][:, 0], d["logsfr_ratios"], galaxy.sfh_edges_gyr)
   153	    log_sfr = log_sfr.reshape(repeats, n, -1)
   154	    values = [pgd.marginal_kl_bits(empirical_unit_values(log_sfr[k, :, j], reference[:, j]), w)
   155	              for k, j in enumerate(bins)]
   156	    return float(np.percentile(values, 95))
   157	
   158	
   159	def kl_table(galaxy) -> pd.DataFrame:
   160	    """KL in bits per scalar parameter; err is half the bootstrap 16-84% width.
   161	
   162	    ``logsfr_ratios`` rows are replaced by ``log_sfr_bin[j]`` rows.
   163	    """
   164	    w = pgd.posterior_weights(galaxy)
   165	    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
   166	    picks = rng.integers(0, len(w), (N_BOOT, len(w)))
   167	    columns = {}
   168	    for name, text in galaxy.prior_text.items():
   169	        if name == "logsfr_ratios":
   170	            continue
   171	        prior = pgd.parse_prior(text)
   172	        x = np.asarray(galaxy.samples[name], dtype=float).reshape(len(w), -1)
   173	        for j in range(x.shape[1]):
   174	            key = name if x.shape[1] == 1 else f"{name}[{j}]"
   175	            columns[key] = (label(name, j, galaxy.sfh_edges_gyr), pgd.prior_unit_values(x[:, j], prior))
   176	    posterior = log_sfr_bins(np.asarray(galaxy.samples["logmass"], dtype=float),
   177	                             np.asarray(galaxy.samples["logsfr_ratios"], dtype=float), galaxy.sfh_edges_gyr)
   178	    reference = prior_log_sfr_bins(galaxy, rng, n=PRIOR_SAMPLE_MULT * len(w))
   179	    for j in range(posterior.shape[1]):
   180	        columns[f"log_sfr_bin[{j}]"] = (label("log_sfr_bin", j, galaxy.sfh_edges_gyr),
   181	                                        empirical_unit_values(posterior[:, j], reference[:, j]))
   182	    rows = []
   183	    for key, (text, u) in columns.items():
   184	        boot = [pgd.marginal_kl_bits(u[i], w[i]) for i in picks]
   185	        rows.append({"parameter": key, "label": text, "bits": pgd.marginal_kl_bits(u, w),
   186	                     "err": 0.5 * np.subtract(*np.percentile(boot, [84, 16]))})
   187	    return pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("parameter")
   188	
   189	
   190	def total_kl_bits(galaxy) -> float:
   191	    """Joint D_KL over all parameters: (<ln L>_posterior - ln Z) / ln 2."""
   192	    w = pgd.posterior_weights(galaxy)
   193	    return float((np.sum(w * galaxy.log_likelihoods) - galaxy.log_evidence) / np.log(2))
   194	
   195	
   196	def main() -> None:
   197	    matplotlib.use("Agg")  # CLI only; a notebook keeps its inline backend
   198	    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   199	    galaxies = {k: pgd.load_galaxy(folder) for k, (folder, _c, _n) in FITS.items()}
   200	    kl = {k: kl_table(g) for k, g in galaxies.items()}
   201	    table = pd.concat({k: t[["bits", "err"]] for k, t in kl.items()}, axis=1)
   202	    order = table[("C", "bits")].sort_values(ascending=False).index
   203	    table = table.loc[order]
   204	    table.columns = [f"{k}_{c}" for k, c in table.columns]
   205	    table.loc["sum_of_marginals"] = {f"{k}_bits": t["bits"].sum() for k, t in kl.items()}
   206	    table.loc["total_joint"] = {f"{k}_bits": total_kl_bits(g) for k, g in galaxies.items()}
   207	    table.to_csv(OUT_DIR / f"kl-{TARGET}.csv", float_format="%.3f")
   208	    print(table.round(2).to_string())
   209	
   210	    labels = pd.concat([t["label"] for t in kl.values()]).groupby(level=0).first().loc[order]
   211	    y = np.arange(len(order))[::-1]
   212	    h = 0.8 / len(kl)
   213	    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 6.8))
   214	    for n, (k, t) in enumerate(kl.items()):
   215	        t = t.reindex(order)
   216	        yy = y + 0.4 - h * (n + 0.5)
   217	        ax.barh(yy, t["bits"], height=h, color=FITS[k][1], label=FITS[k][2], alpha=0.85)
   218	        ax.errorbar(t["bits"], yy, xerr=t["err"], fmt="none", ecolor="0.4", lw=0.8, capsize=1.5)
   219	    ax.set_yticks(y)
   220	    ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=9)
   221	    ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)
   222	    ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(order) - 0.4)
   223	    ax.set_xlabel(r"$D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\mathrm{posterior}\,\|\,\mathrm{prior})$ [bits]")
   224	    ax.grid(axis="x", color="0.9", lw=0.6)
   225	    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
   226	    ax.legend(loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1.0), frameon=False, fontsize=8,
   227	              borderaxespad=0.0, title=TARGET)
   228	    fig.savefig(OUT_DIR / f"kl-{TARGET}.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
   229	    plt.close(fig)
   230	
   231	
   232	if __name__ == "__main__":
   233	    main()
